verdict.rationale: Aleph's own materials explicitly claim bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows with pull/push sync, reporting automation and drill-down (aleph-docs-2). Its overview and spreadsheets pages reinforce spreadsheet-native models kept in sync with a single source of truth (aleph-docs-1, aleph-docs-17, aleph-probe-1). Evidence is limited to marketing-level claims, and there are no detailed docs on how the add-in installs, refreshes or writes back. Missing for 10: detailed add-in documentation (installation, live refresh mechanics, write-back behavior and conflict handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.
